package.name: chopped_urdf_v2
package.description: BracketBot chopped_urdf_v2: the Onshape chopped_urdf_v2 base re-aligned to the v1 root convention (wheel-axle midpoint over the origin, tyres on z=0), with the chopped_urdf_v1 arm subtree raised by the 38.59 mm the mast gained. Ported to ROS 2 (ament_cmake) so package:// mesh URIs resolve for robot_state_publisher, xacro, and Gazebo Sim; the ROS 1 launch file is kept for reference but is no longer the primary build (see gazebo_sim/).
